Container.Name: Matinee
Container.Overview:
Matinee is a free and open source media server for your movies, TV shows and music. It finds posters, descriptions, cast and trailers for everything in your shares, then streams to any web browser and to the Matinee apps for iPhone, iPad, Android, Apple TV and Android TV. It transcodes with your GPU when there is one, gives everyone in the house their own profile with a kids mode, and keeps your place across devices.
Open the WebUI to create the admin account, then add libraries from /media. Pass /dev/dri for an Intel or AMD GPU. The guide is at https://matinee.yeix.io/docs/getting-started/nas/
Container.DonateText: Matinee is free. Donations help pay for a shared posters-and-details key.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port Matinee answers on. With host networking this is the port on your server. Change it with MATINEE_ADDR below.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Matinee's database, image cache and scratch space for converting video. Keep it on the cache drive.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media shares, read-only. Matinee's library picker starts here.

Config.Name: GPU (Intel or AMD)
Config.Description: Hardware transcoding. Remove this if your server has no GPU. For NVIDIA, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES below.

Config.Name: MATINEE_MEDIA_ROOT
Config.Description: Folder the library picker starts in.

Config.Name: MATINEE_TMDB_KEY
Config.Description: Optional themoviedb.org key for posters and details. You can also add it later in Settings.

Config.Name: MATINEE_SERVER_NAME
Config.Description: The name the phone and TV apps show for this server.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: For an NVIDIA GPU with the Nvidia Driver plugin: all, or the GPU's UUID. Leave empty otherwise.
